title: How can you reduce manual review in commercial credit underwriting?
summary: Discover actionable operational strategies commercial lenders use to cut manual underwriting review times, raise straight-through processing, and scale loan volume.
body_markdown:
Faster decisions alone do not show whether automation has reduced the work needed to fund a loan. Measure time, manual involvement, cost, and the quality of decision records to see where the process has improved:


Turnaround time (TAT): Track time from application submission to credit decision. Measure time to funding separately so you can see whether faster decisions also help borrowers get funds sooner.


Straight-through processing (STP) rate: For an application-to-funding workflow, measure the share of submitted applications that reach funding without manual intervention. Track automated declines separately.


Underwriting cost per funded loan: Reducing the labor hours required to decision each file, lowering origination expenses across small-dollar portfolios.


Auditability and consistency: Replacing informal analyst notes with immutable, API-generated decision logs that document exact verification criteria under fair lending rules.


Middesk provides the operational foundation for lenders seeking to eliminate manual underwriting reviews. By automating business verification and public record searches, Middesk helps lenders scale origination and deliver instant credit decisions.
